QUOTE: The `scope` block gives the file count (426), the top-level directories, the extensions indexed, and a `not_indexed` list with counts. In this repo that list covers `.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, `.csv`, `.lock`, `.motor`, `.jsonl` and extensionless files.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item requires naming in-scope file types that produced no rows, which separates "absent" from "not indexed". The answer only lists `not_indexed` (out-of-scope) file types and never says the reply names in-scope types with zero rows.
